errors.text: The hypothesis assigns the critical ordering evolution to coherent B2 precipitates, whereas the target mechanism is enhanced L12 ordering within FCC domains coupled to jagged FCC/B2 phase boundaries.
It replaces stress concentration and dislocation pile-up at jagged phase-boundary tips with a speculative coherent-to-incoherent precipitate transition and Orowan bypass mechanism.
It does not define the required approximate 550-750°C brittle window, the ductility minimum near 600°C, or recovery near 750°C.

The cited nanowire evidence concerns lattice-parameter-disorder friction, not the established effect of ordered domains—high antiphase-boundary energy suppressing cross-slip and promoting planar slip.
